contract.status: PB1 neutral contract; planned experimental work; not ratified; not part of Brontide Base

canonicalReference.normalizes: PB0 finding 1: Cooling v2 uses structured {name,version}; Catalog v1 uses 'name@version' strings.

structuredForm.encoding: record with exactly the fields below; unknown fields are rejected

permittedPositions: map keys where a single string key is structurally required, specifically the fragment map of a record value
textForm.rule: The text form is a rendering of the structured form and never a distinct identity. Parsing splits on the last '@'.

canonicalNamePortableProfile.sourceRule: Non-empty, equal to its own trim, at most one ':' separating an authority path from a concept path; each path splits on '.' into non-empty segments whose characters are Unicode letter-or-digit, '_' or '-'.
canonicalNamePortableProfile.portableNarrowing: The portable profile restricts segment characters to ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_-]. This is a deliberate narrowing of the Reference rule, recorded here rather than left implicit: a Unicode-letter name is a valid Brontide canonical name but is not portable in binding 0.1.

identitySpaces.note: The Component whose contract is established.
An input, result, or detail Shape.
A declared profile or binding dependency.
Identifies one binding scope; see binding-plan.json.

compactIdentifiers.rule: A binding may assign compact unsigned-integer identifiers to negotiated Operation, Shape, and Fragment references after canonical negotiation succeeds.
constraints: A compact identifier is scoped to one established binding and is meaningless outside it.
A compact identifier never appears in a Binding Plan fact, an observation, or any persisted artifact as identity.
A compact identifier is never assigned before canonical negotiation completes.
Receiving a compact identifier that was not assigned in the current binding is 'unsupported-contract'.
Compact identifiers occupy the unsigned range 0..65535.
compactIdentifiers.gapClosed: PB0 recorded compact identifiers as missing from both experiments; this is their first neutral definition.

scalars.name: Text
scalars.domain: Unicode scalar sequence encoded as UTF-8
scalars.fixtureUse: Cooling 'loop', 'failureMode'; Catalog item names and tags

scalars.name: Decimal
scalars.domain: exact decimal fraction: mantissa (Integer.Signed64) scaled by 10^exponent
scalars.fixtureUse: declared floor member; no current Cooling or Catalog fixture uses it
scalars.note: Both stack codecs currently reject Decimal at the boundary. It is declared here because the portable floor must state its scalar set once; a stack that does not implement it declares so through an unsupported-contract negotiation failure rather than by silently accepting and mangling the value.

composites.rule: Carries no information. Legal only where the declared Shape is unit.
An ordered-by-encoding map of declared fields plus a map of attached Fragments.
fieldRules: Field names are unique and match the portable member-token profile [A-Za-z0-9_-]+.
A required field must be present.

An optional field is either present with a conforming value or absent. A present-but-null optional field is 'invalid-payload' unless its declared Shape is unit, which is the one Shape whose value encodes as null.
A field not declared by the Shape is governed by fragmentPolicy and the projection rules below.

fragmentPolicy.open: Undeclared Fragments may be attached and are projected away by a consumer that does not recognize them.
fragmentPolicy.closed: Only Fragments declared by the negotiated Operation may be attached; any other Fragment is 'invalid-payload'.

composites.rule: An ordered, homogeneous list of the declared item Shape. Order is semantic and is preserved exactly.
Exactly one named alternative and its value. An alternative not declared by the Shape is 'invalid-payload' rather than 'unsupported-kind', because the envelope kind was recognized.

projection.additiveRule: A consumer recognizing Shape version N accepts a payload declared at version M > N when every difference is additive: new optional fields and new Fragments. It projects the payload to version N by canonically ignoring the unrecognized additive structure.
projection.nonAdditiveRule: A new required field, a removed field, a changed field Shape, or a changed cardinality is not additive. The result is 'invalid-payload' and no provider effect begins.

constraintValueExemption.rule: Values in an authority or control position are never projected. An unrecognized Constraint value version makes the atom Unknown and the request is denied locally; no frame crosses a pre-provider boundary.
constraintValueExemption.rationale: Projection discards unrecognized structure. Discarding narrowing semantics from an authority value would widen authority, so payload covariance must not reach authority positions.

forbiddenContent.rule: No exception, stack trace, runtime type identity, or authority object representation may appear in any position.
forbiddenContent.outcome: A rejected field name in a control position is 'malformed-message'; in a declared payload position it is 'invalid-payload'.
forbiddenContent.derivedFrom: BoundaryJson.ForbiddenProperties in both stacks, generalized to the neutral contract
